notes.title: Bug fixes and spooky mode
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed one icon from not disappearing when starting a game
 Fixed bug with one of the controls

Spooky mode

Normal game mode, but with a spooky background and graphics.
 Mainly for those who really want a spooky theme while playing.

notes.title: Lots of quality of life changes, bug fixes, etc
notes.notes:
This is mostly an experimental game I made to test certain things out. A bit was changed/updated for quality of life outside smaller changes.


 Full Screen Button was added.
 The game's resolution naturally scales to how big the border is, made some changes to have double checks for it to be enabled to scale before preventing that ability if it detects it's being run on a mobile device.
 Added more options for sound control.
 Added keyboard controls so the Q, E, and Space buttons can be used if the mouse is not on the game window.
 Changed some settings so it runs better on very lower end devices (You can probably run this on a 7 year old phone now)
